problem: Bracket the unique four-corner active-pair mixing weight root D(rho)=E_q[(f_ell-f_u)/(rho f_ell+(1-rho)f_u)]=0 with a directed probability-partition certificate, without independently bounding f_ell and f_u and thereby losing their common W/y dependence.

analytic_structure.derivative: D'(rho)=-E_q[(f_ell-f_u)^2/(rho f_ell+(1-rho)f_u)^2] < 0 except the degenerate equal-scale case, hence the root is unique.
analytic_structure.active_identity: rho C_ell+(1-rho)C_u=1 identically. At D=0, C_ell=C_u, so both equal 1; symmetric +/-h components then give all four active-corner expectations equal to 1 once the exact root is enclosed/solved.
analytic_structure.scale_ratio: Let t=f_ell/f_u. Then g(t,rho)=(t-1)/(rho t+1-rho), increasing in t.
analytic_structure.log_t: 32 log(u/ell) - 0.5*(W+32(y^2+h^2))*(1/ell^2-1/u^2) + log cosh(32 h y/ell^2)-log cosh(32 h y/u^2).
analytic_structure.monotonicity: log t decreases in W and in |y| over the frozen parameter range; therefore each probability cell obtains a coupled t interval from W/|y| endpoints, avoiding independent numerator/denominator dependency blow-up.

arithmetic.probability_grid: N=256 R/U equal-probability grid using the r97 elementary-certified +/-4e-15 quantile boxes.
arithmetic.directed_machine_path: Same 70-decimal FLOOR/CEILING and 120-decimal widened sqrt/exp path as r98/r99. Monotone t endpoints are transformed through g(t,rho), and all cell contributions are downward/upward summed to enclose D(rho).
